title: 8 February 1961: Live: Hambleton Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ third performance at Hambleton Hall in Huyton, Liverpool.

It was booked by Wally Hill and Vic Anton, the promoters at the hall at the east of Liverpool. Hambleton Hall was a shabby municipal building which later became a probation office, situated on St David’s Road in Page Moss, Huyton.

Earlier in this evening The Beatles had given their eighth performance at Aintree Institute in Liverpool, after which they were driven by Neil Aspinall to Hambleton Hall.

The Beatles played at Hambleton Hall on 16 occasions. The other dates were 25 January; 1, 15 and 22 February; 8 and 20 March; 20 August; 3 and 17 September; 15 and 29 October; 12 and 26 November; 10 December 1961; and 13 January 1962.
